roleplay.title: Weekend plans in the break room

hints.en: Say on Saturday you're going to work and on Sunday you're going to the movies with your wife.
hints.es: El sábado voy a trabajar y el domingo voy a ir al cine con mi esposa.

hints.en: Ask what she's going to do on Sunday.
hints.es: ¿Y tú qué vas a hacer el domingo?

hints.en: Ask how long she has lived in Chicago.
Ask whether she has ever been to a baseball game.
hints.es: ¿Alguna vez has ido a un partido de béisbol?

hints.en: Ask what she has been up to lately.
Say nice to meet him, you're his new neighbor, and you've lived here for a week.
hints.es: Mucho gusto, soy su nuevo vecino. Vivo aquí desde hace una semana.

hints.en: Ask how long he has been living here.
hints.es: ¿Y usted, cuánto tiempo lleva viviendo aquí?

hints.en: Ask what he's going to do in December.
Ask whether he has ever traveled by plane.
Ask what he has been up to lately.
